question: Sadhna S Nair is the second woman officer from the _____ branch of the Indian Air Force (IAF) to attain the esteemed rank of Air Marshal.
solution:
The correct answer is __**medical**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Air chief marshal is a four-star air officer rank in The Indian Air force. He is the Chief of the Air Staff.
 
• The rank of the Chief of the Air Staff was upgraded from Air Marshal to Air Chief Marshal in 1966.
 
• The Appointments of the Chief of the Air Staff are made by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC), which is chaired by the Prime Minister of India. The term length of the Chief of the Air Staff is three years or until the age of 62 of the holder, whichever is earlier.
 
• The current Chief of the Air Staff of the Indian Air Force is Mr Rakesh Singh Bhadauria. He is an alumnus of National Defence Academy, Pune and holds a Masters in Defence studies from Command and Staff College.
 
• He is the 25th Chief of The Air Staff.
 
• He was commissioned into the fighter stream of the Indian Air Force on 15 June 1980 with the Sword of Honour.
 
• He has clocked over 4250 hours of flying and has experienced in 26 different types of fighter jets and transport aircraft.
 
• Notes:
 
 
• The first Air Chief Marshal of The Indian Air Force was Mr Arjan Singh Aulakh in1966. He was the first person who was promoted to the Air Marshal to Air Chief Marshal rank in 1966.
 
• The headquarters of The Indian Air Force is located in New Delhi.
